searchText: Is there any effort to remove "totalDifficulty" from GetBlockByHash? I think this field can just be removed without many to complain from the jsonrpc also this would allow for further simplifications in the clients from pre-merge debt there haven’t been any efforts to do so Is there anything impeding us to do so? i know block explorers use it but I doubt that it serves any real utility at a functional level so my question would be: would it be okay to deprecate it in the shorter term? honestly i can’t say, i’d like to better know who is using it and how before saying it seems like something reasonable to look into though so the reason why I am asking is that in Erigon - there would be a significant optimization with "hot-data" (which is something we want to keep as small as possible e.g <5GB), and getting rid of it could help for us i would be fine advocating for this but i do not know where to start really 🙂 I would make a PR to ethereum/exeuction-apis with motivation and some discussion of implications, then post it to the ACDE agenda and get a tempurature check from other clients ok, thank you for the advice, will go through with this <@&652918665943056397> <@&836981603216654336> <@&1070471163219824730> <@&688090867927482525> any preliminary thoughts on this? this is used for the merge transition tests, so we'd have to remove those or figure out some other way to do them. otherwise we're in favor of removing td from rpc Nethermind used to use it for trustless syncing. Not sure if they still do. Do transition tests require rpc? you are free to keep it as an internal, it is just a remotion from rpc I guess - same point, remotion is only from rpc, anyway I will raise a PR in execution-apis If it isn't possible to get total difficulty from an RPC, then users will have a hard time providing Nethermind's sync with total difficulty. This may not matter anymore since the switch to PoS. i think so. this is not our tests, its in hive iirc ah, yeah i mean the check can just be removed there i suspect, I will add this to the PR desc I made the PR: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/570
